title: Consecutive-thickening naturality of canonical finite etale coordinates
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $f:R\to S$, $V$ an open of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $P\to V$ finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Let $V_n$ and $P_n$ be the pullbacks along $\operatorname{Spec}(R/\ker(f)^{n+1})$, with projections $g_n:V_n\to V$ and $k_n:P_n\to P$. Define $b_n:g_n^*(p_*\mathcal O_P)\to(p_n)_*\mathcal O_{P_n}$ as the adjoint of restriction along $k_n$, transported through the commuting pushforwards [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For any $r$ and sheaf morphism $\alpha:p_*\mathcal O_P\to\mathcal O_V^r$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], define the coordinates of $a\in\Gamma(P_n,\mathcal O)$ by applying $g_n^*\alpha$ and the canonical free pullback isomorphism to the function inverse of $\Gamma(b_n)$ at $a$. These coordinates commute with every consecutive transition $P_n\to P_{n+1}$ and $V_n\to V_{n+1}$, as precisely stated by pushforward_coordinates_transition. No Noetherian, injectivity, or scalar comparison hypothesis is assumed.

theorem pushforward_coordinates_transition :
    ∀ (r : ℕ)
      (α : (Modules.pushforward P.obj.hom).obj (Modules.unit P.obj.left) ⟶
        free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Γ(cover f V P (n + 1), ⊤)) (i : Fin r),
        coordinates f V P α n ((coverTransition f V P n).appTop a) i =
          (pullback.lift (pullback.fst V.ι (baseMap f n))
            (pullback.snd V.ι (baseMap f n) ≫ baseTransition f n)
            (by rw [Category.assoc, baseTransition_comp_baseMap]
                exact pullback.condition)).appTop
                  (coordinates f V P α (n + 1) a i))
